items.t: Oil burning and fouled spark plugs (VCM)
items.job: Clean or replace piston rings and replace spark plugs
items.note: Plugs alone are far cheaper, but the problem returns if the rings are the cause.

items.t: Rough running or rattle at steady cruise (VCM)
Shudder at light throttle (2010 torque converter)
items.job: Update transmission software or replace torque converter
items.note: The low end is a software update and fluid change; the high end is a new torque converter.

items.job: Transmission software update and fluid change
items.note: Replacing the torque converter, if needed, costs much more.

items.t: Steering suddenly turns heavy (power steering unit failure)
items.job: Replace power steering control unit or rack
items.note: Often covered by Honda's 15-year warranty extension. CarComplaints owners report about $4,200 when paid out of pocket.

items.t: Grinding rattle on cold start (VTC actuator)
Vibration at idle or while driving
items.note: Active (electronically controlled) mounts on the V6 cost more.

items.job: Replace brake pads (and rotors if worn)

items.t: Low oil reading and check engine light from software

items.job: Clean screen bezel or replace display

items.t: Rubbing or groaning from the steering wheel
items.job: Adjust or shim driver airbag module

items.t: Paint peeling on White Diamond Pearl cars

items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,200 for repeat replacements.
